# Focus Academy

> Nepal's premier US Tax training institute. Become a job-ready US tax preparer in 30 days with IRS Enrolled Agent-led classes, hands-on Form 1040/1120/1065 practice, and remote job support.

Focus Academy is a Kathmandu-based training program that prepares accountants, CA/ACCA students, and finance professionals in Nepal for remote US taxation careers. Instruction is in Neplish (Nepali + English) and covers individual, corporate, and partnership tax returns. Course fee: NPR 20,000 + VAT.
